reviews.text: Amanda looked after our lively Labrador Milo and our crazy cats! She did a brilliant job caring for them and their individual needs. One of our cats has an illness so we needed to know he was getting his medication, we were reassured by Amanda’s commitment to knowing exactly what he needed. One cat can’t go outside so this can be hard to manage with the other animals but Amanda juggled it all. Thank you so much. We will be in touch soon about next time! Would definitely recommend…❤️

Thank you again Amanda and Richard for looking after Kyra! Exceptional service knowing your dog is well and truly looked after while away. Accommodating to all Kyra’s care plans and feeding her five times a day due to her bout of pancreatitis. Couldn’t ask for a better dog service. Thank you once again!

Amanda walks our golden retriever every day. He loves his walks and getting to see his friends and rushes to the door wagging his tail when she arrives. Amanda is reliable, flexible and so accommodating to both us and our dog.

If you are looking for a trustworthy walker who will treat your pup like family, look no further than Amanda!
